confirmAnonymize: I understand this permanently erases this person’s details and signed waivers.
anonymizeWarning: Use this only when someone asks for their data to be deleted. To stop someone training here, set their status to Cancelled instead. Erasing removes this member’s personal details, photo, medical notes, promotion notes, signed waivers and check-in access, and clears the household PIN. When no household members remain, it also removes household contacts and portal access. Invoices, payments and attendance stay, without personal details, for the gym’s records.
deleteHouseholdWarning: Only unused households can be deleted. Households with members, invoices or other records are retained.
confirmDeleteTag: Remove this tag from every member and delete it
loadFailed: These details couldn't be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
noMembersHelp: Add your first member, or import a CSV from Import and export.
noMembersReadOnly: Members appear here once staff add or import them.
emptyHelp: Every search word must match a first name, last name or email. Try a different name, status or tag.
chooseHouseholdFirst: Choose a household, or create one, to enter the member's details.
deleteMemberWarning: Use this for a member added by mistake, such as a duplicate, a typo or a test. Deleting removes the member with their attendance, bookings, check-in code, promotions, signed waivers and portal login, and their household too when they are its last member. It can’t be undone. Once a member has billing records (invoices, payments, saved cards, invoiced memberships, discounts, class packs or credits), they can’t be deleted: set their status to Cancelled, or erase their personal data.
deleteMemberConfirm: Type the member’s name, {name}, to confirm.
deleteMemberBlocked: This member has billing records, so they can’t be deleted. Set their status to Cancelled, or erase their personal data instead.
